subject: Threeway interaction on within-person level in LCM-SR

messages.author: 1af0beb2477021b2
messages.subject: Threeway interaction on within-person level in LCM-SR
parts:
Hi!
I have fitted a latent growth curve model with structured residuals investigating two constructs over the course of time. I want to see how the combination of treatment ( coded 1 and 2) and trauma category (coded 0 and 1) affect the cross-lagged predictions on a within-person level. 

This is my syntax on the within-person cross-lagged predictions: 

# ---------------------------
# residual regressions
# ---------------------------
# sk
#ssk2 ~ p2*ssk1 + p4*ede1
ssk3 ~ p2*ssk2 + p4*ede2
ssk4 ~ p2*ssk3 + p4*ede3
ssk5 ~ p2*ssk4 + p4*ede4
ssk6 ~ p2*ssk5 + p4*ede5
ssk7 ~ p2*ssk6 + p4*ede6
ssk8 ~ p2*ssk7 + p4*ede7
ssk9 ~ p2*ssk8 + p4*ede8
ssk10 ~ p2*ssk9 + p4*ede9
ssk11 ~ p2*ssk10 + p4*ede10

# ede
#sede2 ~ p5*sede1 + p3*ssk1
sede3 ~ p5*sede2 + p3*ssk2
sede4 ~ p5*sede3 + p3*ssk3
sede5 ~ p5*sede4 + p3*ssk4
sede6 ~ p5*sede5 + p3*ssk5
sede7 ~ p5*sede6 + p3*ssk6
sede8 ~ p5*sede7 + p3*ssk7
sede9 ~ p5*sede8 + p3*ssk8
sede10 ~ p5*sede9 + p3*ssk9
sede11 ~ p5*sede10 + p3*ssk10

How do I find out (i.e. code) if whether or not you have trauma background and received treatment X affects within-person effect in the cross-lagged predictions? 

Thanks for any guidance, 
 Maren
